sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Intellect is a Mental skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: High intellect boosts the speed of item examination, lock picking, and improves the quality of weapon repairs.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The elite effects of this skill do not work.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases item examination speed (2% per level → +100% at Elite Level)
- Increases weapon repair effectiveness (2% per level → +100% at Elite Level)
- Reduces repair kit durability consumption (0.5% per level → -25% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Ammo counter
- Elite level: Guess container contents without searching
- Elite level: You do not need a manual for item examination

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Craft items in the Hideout
- Repairing Body armor using a Body armor repair kit
  - Every ~10 durability points repaired grant 0.4 points of Intellect skill
- Repairing Weapons using a Weapon repair kit
  - Every ~10 durability points repaired grant 0.4 points of Intellect skill
- Completing the quest Shooter Born in Heaven
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Setting Priorities
- Completing the quest Calibration
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
